issue.title: Cut post-wait admission latency from the ~11 s capacity-only runner-slot scan under the host-wide lock

task_type_fields.proposal:
Investigate and cut the post-release admission latency the research report flagged as a parallel track. After a wait releases, the runner waits for a runner slot through a capacity-only artifact scan under the host-wide slot lock (~11 s measured during research). sase-1hf added `admission_latency_s` (run_started_at − wait_completed_at) and `runner_slot_wait_s` (run_started_at − entry into `wait_for_runner_slot`) to agent_meta.json to quantify it.

1. After deploy, tally both keys over a representative window.
2. If the slot scan dominates, make the capacity check incremental or index-backed, or shrink the critical section under the host-wide lock (`src/sase/axe/run_agent_wait_slots.py`, `run_agent_wait_slot_candidate.py`, `_admit_and_launch` in `run_agent_runner.py`).

Related: sase-zd (closed) narrowed the capacity_only scan.

Proposed by phase bead sase-1hf.5 (lane-split) in PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1, item 6. Filed by the sase-1hf land agent.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: sase-1hf covered the wait-release lane only. Admission after release is a separate path (runner-slot capacity under the host-wide lock), and the research report scoped it as a parallel track.

issue.creation_reason: The wait-wakeup research flagged admission after release as a parallel latency track; sase-1hf added admission_latency_s and runner_slot_wait_s to measure it but did not change admission.
